answer: Neighborhood conductance floor. Each identity's transaction graph must maintain an edge-conductance ratio above a threshold: its links must diffuse across at least two otherwise weakly connected clusters, verified via spectral partitioning each epoch. A sybil cluster seeded to satisfy this must weave a velvet of cross-cluster edges, paying real latency and capital to sustain them under partition churn. Isolated pockets fail like a glacier calving off. Attacker cost: provisioning genuine cross-cluster counterparties and pigment of distinct activity per node, scaling linearly with cluster size.
